theme_strategy.justification: Light mode maximizes legibility for OCR scanning, dense data tables, and government-style administrative dashboards. It aligns with the 'no-frills, speed-first' constraint.

headings.usage: Use for page titles (Adhikar), table headers, and section labels.

body.usage: Use for all OCR text, data table rows, and form fields to give a highly legible, tabular feel.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) for Admin Panels
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-4 and p-6 generously for container padding. For dense tables, use tight padding py-2 px-4.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Flat, cardless look. Use border border-zinc-200 rounded-md bg-white. NO shadows to maintain speed/no-frills.

components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast (Black/White). Avoid gradients.
components.badges: Flat background with 1px border matching the semantic color. Use for Validation Statuses.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Clean lines, text-sm, hover:bg-zinc-50.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input/Textarea. border-zinc-300, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:border-zinc-900.
components.map: Leaflet container must have z-10 (not higher, to avoid breaking dropdowns), rounded-md, border border-zinc-200. Ensure it has a defined height (e.g., h-[500px] or h-full min-h-[400px]).

scanned_document_seed.description: A scanned printed text page to be used as a seed image placeholder for the Land Record OCR preview.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers.
Every interactive element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='approve-record-button'`).
Do not use AI emoji characters (🤖, 💡, etc.) anywhere in the UI. Use Lucide icons instead.
Ensure map components (Leaflet) are initialized with proper z-index context so they do not overlap Shadcn modals/dialogs.
Adhere strictly to the chosen font pairing: Work Sans for headers, IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not default to Inter for headings.
Make the Officer Review Dashboard table filterable by Status.
For the Side-by-Side review, ensure containers are scrollable independently (overflow-y-auto) if content is tall, so the overall page doesn't scroll excessively.
